contract.generation: Use built-in imagegen with inspected original source sheets. Produce newly authored detail, materials and lighting; nearest/ScaleNx enlargement alone is not HD completion.
contract.submission_gate: Prepare and inspect sources and save the prompt before acquiring. In one functions.exec orchestration, acquire one of four slots, start the reservation, submit built-in imagegen only when start.changed is true, then classify and report the actual result immediately after await before returning to the model or doing QA. See RustRaptor/docs/hd-generation-workflow.md. Started and legacy-unknown requests require explicit finish; only unstarted reservations expire. If denied or cooling down, prepare/review other jobs. Do not substitute scaling for a failed remaster.
contract.source_truth: Keep every source orientation, silhouette, color identity, logical canvas, anchor and explicit source hash. Use each target's source_palette and source_palette_sha256; Apogee/Cygnus/Taiwan cards use their own palettes, not the gameplay palette. Inspect every frame before generating. Never invent poses or drop damaged/destroyed variants.
contract.ownership: Only this job's target IDs may be proposed. Neighbor/context references and exact-source aliases are reference-only; never claim or overwrite another job's IDs.
contract.raw_output: Keep raw generated PNG bytes, prompts, source references and provenance. Do not retouch generated RGB/alpha. Atlas/square margin crops are allowed only if they preserve all meaningful visible pixels and original aspect.
contract.full_family: Review all frames together at logical resolution and indexed 4× with exact Rust Lanczos3 resident→presentation resampling. A good still does not complete an animation family. Record partial candidates and rejections truthfully.
contract.quality: Check clipping, alpha halos, banking/animation centers, source bounds, pivots, tiny-projectile readability, palette fades/cycling, material continuity and intended timing. Near-black original body/backing pixels are occupied artwork, not empty background. For opaque pictures, mask overlap of 1 proves only coverage; compare source material, landmarks and internal geometry separately. Original ordinary pixels must not gain indices240..255; water/fire/individualblink source classes retain their semantics. Compare original and allscale dynamic-palette counts in runtime-qa.json. Numeric mask metrics support visual review, never replace it.
contract.renderer: Registration is separate from render reachability. Require a verified Rust rendering path and record scene/gallery evidence; unsupported terrain/mask/shader semantics remain explicitly pending.
contract.result: Write candidate.json with job_id, source_sha256 and every proposed target's file/logical dimensions/origin/crop, plus complete sequence metadata and review evidence. Only the coordinator edits global hd.json, completion ledger or provenance.
